overview: Bloodfalls is the vampyric stronghold of Terror of Luclin, where crimson rivers and shadow‑tainted waterfalls feed the Coterie’s power.
history: Crimson rivers formed when void‑scar fractures contaminated natural waterways.
Coterie forces seized the canyon and established ritual sites.
Sanguine beasts mutated from prolonged exposure to corrupted waters.
Vampyre Watch became the region’s primary observation and control point.
Bloodfalls now serves as a major vampyric staging ground.
campaignHooks: Disrupt Coterie rituals powering the crimson falls.
Investigate the source of the sanguine mutation.
Cut off vampyre supply lines flowing through Blood River Run.
Challenge the vampyre commanders at Vampyre Watch.
